Triage: lands in area:ux · domain:ui · Bug · priority:p2 · `pm:blocked` · size S; rationale: on a kanban laned on a lookup, the "uncategorised" lane is not drawn when every empty-lookup record sits past page one, so those records have no entry point. Blocked by #37327; p2 as filed.

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Carried from PR #37511 round 2 (seat nit N7, verdict 7191238306): the past-page lane title read selects only `displayField` and the declared-or-derived name field, so a referenced record with an empty declared name field falls to its raw key instead of the ladder's later rungs, and the read runs before the lane target's definition is ready, so an unprojected read can go out ahead of the projected one (the rig settles the definition first and does not see it).
